title: Macromolecules in Human Physiology
purpose: Connect macromolecule structures and functions to human physiology.

direct_resource.Title: OpenStax Biology 2e: Biological Macromolecules
direct_resource.Task: Click the link and use the chapter introduction and contents for macromolecules. Observe how carbohydrates, lipids, proteins, and nucleic acids support cells. Record each macromolecule and one body-function connection.

mastery_rule: Student can explain the lesson standard with structure-function reasoning and visual/data evidence.
